about: Names and codes for the building blocks the molecules page shows when you tap a residue or read the sequence strip. Three-letter codes are the ones PDB files use (label_comp_id). molecule: a gallery id on this page with that exact building block in 3D. lab: a lab page with a challenge to build it. Sources are numbered on the page next to the residue card.

iupac-1984.cite: IUPAC-IUB Joint Commission on Biochemical Nomenclature. Nomenclature and symbolism for amino acids and peptides. European Journal of Biochemistry 138 (1984) 9-37.
iupac-1984.used_for: Three-letter and one-letter codes and names of the amino acids.

iupac-1970-nuc.cite: IUPAC-IUB Commission on Biochemical Nomenclature. Abbreviations and symbols for nucleic acids, polynucleotides and their constituents. Biochemistry 9 (1970) 4022-4027.

wimley-white-1996.cite: Wimley WC, White SH. Experimentally determined hydrophobicity scale for proteins at membrane interfaces. Nature Structural Biology 3 (1996) 842-848.
wimley-white-1996.used_for: The water-loving to water-fearing colours (the Mol* hydrophobicity colouring uses this scale, water to membrane interface).

wwpdb-ccd.used_for: The three-letter residue codes in PDB files.
